value.message: Riverbend Community Centre runs Parent & Tot Playtime Tuesdays and Thursdays, 9:30-11:00 a.m., Sept 8 to Dec 11, for 12 months to 4 years - their site says. I could not pin down the price or registration; the page points to the front desk or reception by phone for the fee. I'll keep watching and text you when they post those details.
